title: Non-blocking render guard and fallback when shell TLAS not ready
purpose: Ensure mesh pass never blocks the frame; skip or degrade gracefully until shell TLAS is ready.

steps.detail: In MeshParticleRenderer::render(), if shell TLAS not ready by the time of descriptor push, omit binding 4 and set a push-constant flag to disable self-shadow path.
Print a throttled status: 'Self-shadow TLAS pending...' every ~2s while waiting.
If external TLAS exists, keep external occlusion active. Add a runtime toggle to force-disable self-shadowing for bisecting crashes.

acceptance: Descriptor push succeeds with 2 or 3 descriptors depending on availability
Visible rendering continues in mesh mode
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('Push descriptors optional bindings and missing writes')
notes: Avoid any host waits on render thread. Use logging only for visibility; throttle logs.
